# Plain Metal's generateMipmapsForTexture: on an Apple M3 Max (macOS 26.7, 25G229): the chains of
# share-mips-m3c (our own probe), by store: plain, Private with allowGPUOptimizedContents off; sw,
# Private with ShaderRead and ShaderWrite; pfv, Private with ShaderRead and PixelFormatView (Metal
# compresses none of the three); rt, Private with ShaderRead and RenderTarget, and private, Private,
# both compressed at 16 texels or more on each side. BGRA8Unorm squares from 64 to 4096, rectangles
# to 16384x64 and their transposes, two-slice arrays and cubes (plain), seven of them with sw and
# pfv, three with rt; and 25 formats Private at 256x256 and 2048x32, as strips at 1024x12 and
# 4096x4, and plain at 512x512. Left out: the 8 Private chains whose first level Metal's compressed
# storage rewrote (RG11B10Float, RGB9E5Float, BGRA10_XR and BGRA10_XR_sRGB at 256x256 and 2048x32),
# and the two formats the filter does not compute (B5G6R5Unorm, BGR5A1Unorm). The first levels come
# from measured_m3_passes.txt's probe, keyed by the chain's key. Each level's digest is the first 12
# hex digits of the SHA-256 of its bytes, every layer in turn, rows tight.
# Format:
#   <key> <format> <2d|2darray|cube> <width>x<height> <layers> <pattern>
#   <plain|sw|pfv|rt|private> <digest of level 0> ...
